headline: Product Leader | Vice President — Product Management, JP Morgan | Digital Banking Platforms, AI & Cloud
summary: Product leader with 15 years in banking and financial services across US, UK, EMEA, APAC, and Africa. Currently Vice President — Product Management at JP Morgan, owning strategy, vision, and multi-year roadmap for the global digital loan booking platform — connected via APIs and Kafka across upstream and downstream systems, moving toward straight-through processing powered by a multi-agent AI architecture. Scaled platform user adoption from 40% to 85% in 12 months. Earlier led Standard Bank's core banking modernization (26 partner platforms) over six years in Johannesburg. IIM Kozhikode Executive MBA; pursuing M.Tech in AI from IIT Bhilai.

work_experience.role_description: Own product strategy, vision, multi-year roadmap, and P&L narrative for JP Morgan's digital loan booking platform serving Syndicated Portfolio Lending across CIB and Commercial Banking in US, UK, EMEA, APAC. Built platform connectivity via standardized APIs and Kafka event streaming (Loan IQ, ACBS, underwriting, risk). Led transformation toward straight-through processing with a multi-agent AI architecture (LLM document extraction, RAG covenant intelligence, operator copilots) delivering FTE optimization and cycle-time compression. Scaled user adoption 40%→85% in 12 months via product-led playbook (React UI, embedded Tableau, in-app analytics, discovery-and-experimentation loop). Established AI governance framework, data strategy, North Star Metric, KPI framework. Promoted AVP (2020) → VP (2023).

Clients: Citibank, Standard Bank of South Africa. Led end-to-end core banking modernization at Standard Bank — SAP target architecture, COBOL migration, integration of 26 partner platforms across self-service, branch, and back-office channels. Directed AML compliance programme delivering a zero-finding audit. Championed Waterfall-to-Agile transformation (2016); managed a 38-person globally distributed team across India, South Africa, UK. Earlier delivered multi-year Citibank programmes (core banking, cards, operations) as Project Engineer.

certifications: International Immersion Program — SDA Bocconi, Italy (2025)
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) — Scrum Alliance (2024)
Professional Certification in Product Management — S.P. Jain Global, Dubai (2024)
